summaries.05bde2c4ab3f: Logan City Council's latest news brief covers three items. Adoptable dogs will visit a Bunnings store in Bethania, a new water main at Belivah is starting construction and is due by June 2027, and the Logan Art Gallery is hosting a free opening night for six new exhibitions.
summaries.fa222037362a: Eight Logan artists and arts groups are sharing close to $40,000 in grants from a joint state and council arts fund. The money, backed by Logan City Council and the Queensland Government, is meant to help projects in music, visual arts, community arts and performance.
summaries.79c60f4825da: The NSW government is ending bring-your-own-device requirements for public primary schools from 2027, so parents will not have to buy costly laptops or tablets. Screen-time guidelines also become mandatory in 2028, and secondary schools will be told BYOD programs are voluntary.
summaries.9b69950d214f: Logan City Council's latest news brief highlights a Resilient Creativity event at Logan Central Library on 19 November, with keynote speaker Jason Dasey and other local speakers sharing stories of overcoming setbacks. It also announces that MyCouncil Budget, an interactive online tool that lets residents test budget choices, goes live on 10 November.
summaries.6f897fdc5cb5: The European Union has sued IBM, French IT firm Atos and Italian defence group Leonardo over problems building its Entry/Exit System, the automated border registration system for travellers. The agency says the case concerns only the development phase and the system is fully operational, while the Financial Times reported missed deadlines and disputed fines lay behind the suit.
summaries.15b80e653109: Google has warned that Australia's proposed Digital Duty of Care law could force it to block under-18s from Gmail, as the bill still needs Senate support. A Google policy head told a Senate hearing that age checks could block everyday email and messaging, while Meta, TikTok and Snap raised similar worries about broad regulator discretion.
summaries.78cde1b7546b: Microsoft has reportedly been urging the Trump administration to shelve a planned ban on Chinese optical transceivers, the components that connect servers inside AI data centres. Industry groups argue a ban would slow data centre construction and weaken the US in the AI race, while the FCC is said to be considering a limit covering 3.2 terabit-per-second models.
summaries.25cc50557d98: French authorities have blamed Iran's Revolutionary Guards for early October cyberattacks that cranked up commercial fridges and freezers at hundreds of supermarkets, with at least 15 fires. Officials named a cyber unit linked to the Guards and three alleged associates, and Paris prosecutors have sought international arrest warrants.
summaries.efb813c9c548: Kotaku's guide walks through the multi-step quest chain needed to get the Cozy Sleeping Bag in World of Warcraft: Forever, a napping item that gives a small EXP boost to you and your party. The writer says it is a long, dangerous trek across both continents, with the reward feeling underwhelming for the effort.
summaries.af08b9fffd23: Meta and Disney have rolled out an updated Disney+ app on the Meta Quest store, adding more than 60 3D movies that come with a Disney+ subscription, depending on region and plan. The refresh also adds Disney-themed virtual rooms for streaming, and Meta has begun selling and renting 3D films in its TV app.
summaries.cdd4edc17204: This is a how-to guide rather than news, explaining how to get the Biggoron Sword in the Ocarina of Time remake. The optional sidequest runs as adult Link through a string of fetch steps, from a Pocket Cucco and an Odd Mushroom to Death Mountain and Zora Domain, ending with a three-day forging wait.
summaries.4147b936c1f9: Reports suggest the DC Universe has gone back into reboot mode after James Gunn and Peter Safran left DC Studios, with much of their planned slate reportedly being dismantled. Even David Corenswet's Superman could be replaced, though the writer's tone is more weary than alarmed.
summaries.65649a4667c2: This is a walkthrough rather than news, covering the Water Temple in the Ocarina of Time remake. It walks through raising and lowering the water level with Zelda's Lullaby, collecting keys and the Longshot, and beating Shadow Link and Morpha, with the dungeon described as much easier than the original.
summaries.a0473d7f53bf: Logan City Council's page explains its portable speed advisory signs, which use solar power and radar to show drivers their speed. Drivers at or under the limit see a smiley face, while speeding drivers get a warning to slow down. The signs do not fine or photograph anyone, and they are moved between locations around Logan.
summaries.607196aa9866: Logan City Council is promoting a free after-dark spotlighting walk through Birnam Range Reserve in Jimboomba on Saturday 14 November 2026, from 7 to 9 pm. Led by DDW Fauna, it covers nocturnal wildlife, spotting tips and local conservation work, with registration through Eventbrite because spaces are limited.
